script_text: Stop, Taurus — Mars is drilling a brutal square into your ruling Venus right now. Mars at 3° Aquarius squares your Venus in your 1st House of Self, while Pluto conjunct Mars fires up your 10th House of Career in these Earth-sign waters. Warning: the Mars-Pluto dynamic tempts you to control someone close — don't surrender your power in a negotiation today. Follow for tomorrow's reading — the Moon shifts into a new house and everything changes.
